description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data source within the AttrEval-Simulation. The chart contains five slices, representing different data sources. The “ENTITYQUEST” slice is blue and accounts for 26.0% of the total. “HOTPOTQA” is represented by a red slice and comprises 24.2%. “TRIVIAQA” is shown as an orange slice, representing 22.7% of the data. “POP-QA” is a yellow slice, accounting for 21.6%, and “WEBQUESTIO” is a teal slice representing 3.6%. Percentage labels are displayed adjacent to each slice, and a legend is provided alongside the chart. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
